decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 3 - The kitchen door frame shall be packed off to facilitate central location of the surrounding architrave.
Condition : 4 - The form of the skirting shall match the profile of the skirting in the existing hallway.

Condition : 5 - The former position of the walls shall be marked in accordance with a scheme to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority (e.g. using timber or plaster mouldings) before the relevant part of the works are commenced.

Condition : 6 - The new dividing doors and side panels shall be constructed in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the works are commenced.

Condition : 7 - Informative: This would not normally be considered an appropriate location for a bath (or shower) and the architect should take the maximum care over the specification and installation of any waterproofing and ventillation requirements of the stair soffit.
description: Internal alterations at ground floor level to extend existing W C,  create a bathroom and return a through lounge back to two separate rooms.
